_doc: Owner and culture pinned for fortifications in the LIVE TAOM_Map settlements.xml, which is unversioned. validate_moduledata.py fails SETTLEMENT_ASSIGNMENT_DRIFT when a pinned town or castle, or a village bound to it, no longer matches; tools/apply_settlement_assignments.py --apply writes them back. Villages take the culture of the fortification they are bound to.

castle_K4.reason: Krûk Azhanna is a Khand castle (Mike, 2026-10-30). Varyash already has it as initial_home_settlement in spclans.xslt. It was Rhûn's (clan_khuzait_1) since the #374 retag excluded it.

castle_FH8.reason: Urutúsh belongs to Abanissa, not Shaghana (Mike, 2026-10-30). clan_abanissa_7 holds castle_FH7, the nearest Abanissa fief.
